data.name: Ibrat
data.gender_notes: Ibrat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who gives a reminder or warning to someone. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'ibrahat', which means 'to warn'. It is often given to children who are expected to grow up to be wise and intelligent, and to serve as a reminder to others of important lessons and values. The name Ibrat carries the meaning “Warning, reminder” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ibrat usually hope their child will grow to embody warning, reminder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To inspire and guide others towards the right path. To act as a reminder of the importance of knowledge and wisdom, and to use this knowledge to serve others and make a positive impact on the world.
data.etymology: Ibrat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Warning, reminder.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ibrat total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
